_comment: FICTIONAL data-only example for the made-up 'Lantern Library' app: a request asking for a warehouse re-check, with no screen or endpoint to drive. Same block shape as acceptance.example.json; the item's platform is data and then.surface names the relation it reads, data:<schema>.<table> or data:<database>.<schema>.<table>. The lane's result row for a data item adds object {relation, build} -- the fully qualified relation it actually queried and the CI run or build id that produced it -- and query, the run-relative file holding the SQL it ran; observed.kind is query. smoke-acceptance.test.sh freezes a fictional issue holding the quote.

items.quote: no loan should carry a negative fine after the nightly fines rebuild
items.when: rebuild the fines model in CI and select every fine below zero

then.expect: zero rows with fine_cents below zero
